errors.enterBothDates: Enter both a start and end date, or turn off the date range.
errors.endDateAfterStart: End date must be after the start date.
errors.questionsNotSaved: The questions could not be saved to the question bank. Nothing was created — try again.

toasts.createdWithAi_one: Assessment created and published — {{count}} question, AI checking on for every upload.
toasts.createdWithAi_other: Assessment created and published — {{count}} questions, AI checking on for every upload.
toasts.createdReading: Assessment created and published. Reading the question paper in the background (≈{{credits}} credits) — you will get an alert when it is ready to review.

header.heading: Create assessment
header.description: Learners download the question paper, then upload a PDF answer sheet which you evaluate. Available to every batch that shares this chapter — publish it when ready.

form.subjectDefaultHint: Defaults to the {{subject}} this slide sits under. Change it to tag the assessment elsewhere.
form.taskDescriptionPlaceholder: Write the task description here — upload the question PDF for learners to download.
form.taskDescriptionHint_one: Upload the question paper here. A standard note (download the paper, then start; you'll have {{count}} minute to upload answers) is added automatically.
form.taskDescriptionHint_other: Upload the question paper here. A standard note (download the paper, then start; you'll have {{count}} minutes to upload answers) is added automatically.
form.durationHintBefore: This is the time learners get to
form.durationHintAfter: after clicking Start Assessment — not the time to write their answers (they prepare those beforehand from the question paper).
form.dateRangeLockedHint: The slide stays locked in the course outside this window — learners can only open the assessment while it is live.
form.alwaysAvailableHint: Always available — no start or end date.

aiCheck.title: Check answer sheets with AI
aiCheck.description: Reads the question paper attached above into its questions and marks, so every uploaded answer sheet is marked question by question. Without this, uploads are graded by hand.
aiCheck.attachPdfFirst: Attach the question paper as a PDF in the task description to turn this on.
aiCheck.attachIsNotPdf: The attached file is not a PDF. Export the question paper as a PDF and attach that to turn this on.
aiCheck.whichPaper: Which attachment is the question paper?
aiCheck.estimateFailed: Could not read the attached paper.
aiCheck.estimateLine_one: ≈{{credits}} credits to read the paper ({{count}} page)
aiCheck.estimateLine_other: ≈{{credits}} credits to read the paper ({{count}} pages)
aiCheck.insufficientCredits: Not enough credits to read this paper. Top up, or create the test without AI checking.
aiCheck.perSheetNote: Charged once, when the questions come back. Each uploaded answer sheet is then checked at 1 credit per question.
aiCheck.readingBody: Reading the PDF and extracting every question with its marks. ≈{{credits}} credits will be deducted when it finishes.
aiCheck.readingHint: Usually 1–3 minutes; longer for scanned or many-page papers. You will review the questions and marks before anything is created.
aiCheck.skipNote: If you skip, the read still finishes in the background (and is still charged); its result stays in AI Center → Vsmart Extract history.
aiCheck.failedHeading: Could not read the question paper
aiCheck.failedHint: Nothing was charged and nothing was created. You can try again, or create the test without AI checking and grade uploads by hand.
aiCheck.tookTooLong: Reading the paper is taking longer than expected. Check AI Center → Vsmart Extract in a few minutes, or create the test without AI checking.
aiCheck.noQuestions: No questions could be read from this PDF.
aiCheck.readFailed: The paper could not be read.
aiCheck.lostContact: Lost contact with the AI service while reading the paper.
aiCheck.startFailed: Could not start reading the paper.
aiCheck.reviewClosed: Nothing was created. The questions that were read are kept in AI Center → Vsmart Extract.
aiCheck.turnedOffBecause: AI checking was turned off: {{reason}} Fix the attachment and turn it back on, or create the test and grade uploads by hand.

review.creditsCharged_one: {{credits}} credits deducted for reading the paper ({{count}} page)
review.creditsCharged_other: {{credits}} credits deducted for reading the paper ({{count}} pages)
review.creditsChargedUnknown: About {{credits}} credits for reading the paper (the exact deduction could not be confirmed — check AI Credits)
review.perSheetCost_one: Each uploaded answer sheet will cost ≈{{count}} credit to check (1 per question).
review.perSheetCost_other: Each uploaded answer sheet will cost ≈{{count}} credits to check (1 per question).
review.youEntered: you entered {{total}} — the questions' total will be used
review.marksRequired_one: {{count}} question needs marks greater than 0 before the test can be created.
review.marksRequired_other: {{count}} questions need marks greater than 0 before the test can be created.
review.noAnswer: No answer found - add one in the question bank

choice.title: Internal choice on this paper
choice.hint: Students answer only some questions of these sections. Every answer is checked; only the counted ones make the total.
choice.invalid: Must be at least 1 and less than {{count}} — otherwise every question counts.

ai.title: AI checking settings
ai.hint: Subject, class, your marking scheme and grammar highlighting, used for every answer sheet of this test.

criteria.none: No criteria yet: the AI writes them on the first check

retrofit.title: AI checking is off for this test
retrofit.description: It has only the “Upload your answer sheet” placeholder, so uploads are graded by hand. Read the paper attached in the description into its questions to check every sheet with AI — including the ones already uploaded.
retrofit.noPdf: It has only the “Upload your answer sheet” placeholder and no PDF is attached in its description, so the paper cannot be read. Edit the test description to attach the paper PDF first.
retrofit.confirmBody: Charged once, when the questions come back. You will review the questions and marks before the test is changed; each uploaded sheet is then checked at 1 credit per question.
retrofit.readingBody: Reading the PDF and extracting every question with its marks. The test is not changed until you confirm the questions.
retrofit.failedHint: Nothing was charged and the test was not changed.
retrofit.enableFailed: Could not switch this test to AI checking. The test was not changed.
retrofit.doneReady_one: {{count}} uploaded sheet is ready to be checked.
retrofit.doneReady_other: {{count}} uploaded sheets are ready to be checked.
retrofit.doneGraded_one: {{count}} sheet you had already graded by hand was left unchanged.
retrofit.doneGraded_other: {{count}} sheets you had already graded by hand were left unchanged.
retrofit.doneInProgress_one: {{count}} attempt is still in progress and will be checked when it is submitted.
retrofit.doneInProgress_other: {{count}} attempts are still in progress and will be checked when they are submitted.
retrofit.doneFuture: Every new upload is checked automatically from now on.
retrofit.checkFailed: Could not start the AI check. Use “Evaluate with AI” on the submissions page.
retrofit.criteriaNotSaved: AI checking is on, but the criteria or settings could not be saved. Set them from the test's Submissions tab → Check submitted copies.

background.started: Reading the question paper in the background (≈{{credits}} credits). You can leave this page — you will get an alert when it is ready.
background.readingHint: Usually a few minutes. You can leave this page; you will get an alert when it is ready.
background.readingSince_one: Started {{count}} minute ago. You can leave this page; you will get an alert when it is ready.
background.readingSince_other: Started {{count}} minutes ago. You can leave this page; you will get an alert when it is ready.
background.readyHint: Review the questions and marks to turn on AI checking of the answer sheets.
background.failedInline: The last read failed: {{reason}} Nothing was charged.
background.readyToast: Question paper read for {{name}} — {{count}} questions. Review them to turn on AI checking.
background.failedToast: Could not read the question paper for {{name}}: {{reason}}
background.continuing: The paper is still being read. You will get an alert — and a Review button here — when it is ready.
background.stayNote: Stay on this dialog and the review opens by itself the moment the read finishes.
background.leaveNote: Or continue in the background: you can leave this page, and an alert will tell you when it is ready. The read is charged either way once it finishes.
